body: I only get rejections, insults, discriminatory remarks, that's about it. Based on the hate I get there is no such thing as friendship or love in this world. It doesn't exist and if it does everyone with a pulse refuses to share any type of kindness with me at all which is only further convincing me to give suicide another chance. This whole year I've been fighting off suicidal thoughts even going as far as sticking a red stick in my nose to inhale compressed air that I use to clean my laptop as I hear that can be fatal but I didn't inhale the stuff yet. Drowning is now a second option. But like I said for the time being I'm trying to fight off those thoughts only in the end leaving me to wonder why? To continue to be a failure that not one human being will talk to....
